messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV 2 - elevated container restarts in pool gpu-prefill-5 (5 restarts / 3m). Error: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation in prefill path. Pager notifying @devon (oncall).

/devon (oncall): ack. Seeing crashloops on gpu-prefill-5 pods. Pulling logs now.

/devon (oncall): `kubectl describe pod gpu-prefill-5-9d2b` shows repeated OOM kills, exit code 137. Tail of container log: 
```
[2026-06-02T02:25:10Z] prefill: received request id=xyz-900 size_tokens=118400
[2026-06-02T02:25:11Z] prefill: reserve kv cache ~9.1GiB
[2026-06-02T02:25:11Z] cuda: cudaMalloc returned cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
[2026-06-02T02:25:11Z] runtime: panic - prefill allocation failed, aborting
[2026-06-02T02:25:12Z] kubelet: Container killed by OOM, restarting
```

/maya (sre): joining. Looks like unusually large context/prefill triggered GPU OOMs causing container restarts. Do we know which customer or edge?

/devon (oncall): correlation id xyz-900 -> edge instance edge-09. Headers show account=acct-omega, context_tokens=118400.

/oliver (eng-runtime): joining. Confirmed this matches prefill path allocation problem. Immediate mitigation options: block huge prefill at edge, route to smaller-model fallback or CPU-backed path, cordon noisy node to stop restart churn, or add runtime quick-fail guard.

/harini (prod-ops): can push an emergency edge policy to clamp prefill tokens. Recommend temporary max_prefill_tokens=65536 with instant 429 response. Preparing rollout to edge fleet. ETA ~45s.

/devon (oncall): cordoning gpu-node-21 which is showing repeated driver fragmentation warnings and most of the crashloops observed. Executing `kubectl cordon gpu-node-21 && kubectl drain gpu-node-21 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`.

/ops-bot: Notice: Node gpu-node-21 cordoned. Pods evicted: gpu-prefill-5-7f9c, gpu-prefill-5-9d2b, gpu-prefill-5-b3ac.

/harini (prod-ops): edge policy active. Observing immediate 429s for a small number of requests from edge-09.

/lia (customer-success): compiling list of potentially impacted tenants. Preliminary: acct-omega, sigma-research, neonstudio. I'll draft customer comms and hold until we confirm scope.

/devon (oncall): after node cordon, restart rate dropped from 5 in 3m to 0 in the last 6m. Good sign.

/oliver (eng-runtime): I'll cut an emergency runtime patch to add a prefill memory estimate and fail-fast when estimated allocation exceeds 70% of available GPU memory. Opening PR now and will push a canary image to the cluster after build.

/oliver (eng-runtime): PR rwi/runtime#498 opened - 'add prefill memory guard and metrics'. Build kicked off.

/maya (sre): note: driver logs on gpu-node-21 show fragmentation and repeated allocations failures -> plan to reboot driver stack once pods are drained to clear fragmentation.

/harini (prod-ops): scheduling rolling reboot of gpu-node-21 now. ETA ~7m.

/lia (customer-success): outbound note sent to prelim list: 
"We observed transient instability affecting GPU-backed generation due to very large context requests. We've applied a temporary limit to protect availability and are investigating. If you rely on ultra-large contexts, please reply and we'll discuss dedicated capacity or alternatives."

/devon (oncall): handing incident to maya (sre) for follow-up. Handoff notes: root cause likely oversized prefill requests (~118k tokens) from acct-omega causing cuda allocation failures; mitigations: applied edge clamp to 65536 tokens, cordoned and drained gpu-node-21, initiated node reboot, emergency runtime PR in progress, customer outreach started.

/incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Alert state: mitigated - container restart rate returned below threshold for pool gpu-prefill-5. Assigning follow-up to eng-runtime (oliver) for post-incident action items.

/oliver (eng-runtime): owning postmortem. Action items: 1) ship prefill memory guard and promote to stable; 2) add per-account request-size telemetry and configurable throttles; 3) edge-admission tied to instance memory; 4) investigate driver/fragmentation telemetry and auto-proactive reboots. Will create follow-up tickets and ETA.

/maya (sre): I'll stay on to monitor until 06:00 UTC and will schedule a postmortem meeting with eng-runtime, eng-sre, product, and customer-success.

/lia (customer-success): accounts notified. acct-omega responded requesting logs and ETA. Will coordinate with eng-runtime for timeline and any mitigations.

/devon (oncall): final note: please review SDKs and examples - avoid naive client-side loops that can accidentally send massive prefill payloads. Attached sample request payload to incident doc.

/maya (sre): handoff complete.

/incident-bot: log: thread closed at 1780005123, incident archived for follow-up and postmortem.
